proximityIntent.source: Eric's current direct voice statements, relayed by parent; local access descriptions are owner-reported, not an independent walk survey.

preferred_cluster.base_load_scope: 9 + 3 + 1 + 6 = 19 simple group-load points, not a combined proximity/load score.
preferred_cluster.preference: Prefer keeping these relatively close groups together when practical; SPLITTABLE, not a hard assignment lock.
source_quotes: That's ... a preference I try to keep together
we gotta do what we gotta do
access_notes: Primate Pavilion is directly across the street from Zambezi.
Primate Canyon is near Pavilion/across the street, with simple access.
The Breezeway route passes through a gate, but Eric includes it in the accepted tight cluster and did not state a major barrier.

overlapping_adjacency.owner_description: Canyon is also very close to China and Bonobos. Zambezi is on the south side and China on the north side.
overlapping_adjacency.source_quote: that doesn't necessarily tie them into the Zambezi side
overlapping_adjacency.interpretation: Record overlapping adjacency with Canyon bridging alternative groupings, NOT a transitive all-nearby mega-cluster, hard lock or assignment change.

flexibility_confirmation.source_quote: Yeah ... you could go one side or the other.
flexibility_confirmation.meaning: Canyon can fit either neighboring side; no fixed cluster membership or assignment change.

explicit_directives.tammy_route: Eric says Teton, Northwest Passage and East End restrooms connect directly by front/back routes; no special route exception is needed.
explicit_directives.barriers: Eric will flag detours or barriers case by case. No exhaustive access/barrier audit now.
explicit_directives.estimate_limit: GPS distance is a baseline estimate, not a verified walking distance or travel time.
explicit_directives.workflow: Develop the new own method in planning, independent of legacy grid/formula/overrides; no integration or production edits now.

groups: Education (includes Volunteer, IT, Interpretation, and four classrooms)
entrance_area_neighborhood.correction: PRIMATE CANYON, not Primate Pavilion, is the location in this entrance-neighborhood description.
owner_walking_description: From Admissions, roughly 50–60 feet to Courtyard restrooms on the left.
Then roughly another 70 feet to Breezeway restrooms on the right/opposite side of the Nile River.
Breezeway leads to Education and the classroom row, described as like storefronts.
Nocturnal is across the street; Canyon is accessible from this area.
Cat House Cafe is almost straight ahead/slightly left from Admissions.
entrance_area_neighborhood.limits: Approximate owner-reported walking descriptions, not surveyed coordinates, measured walking lengths or all-pairs distances. Cat Country is included in the stated neighborhood without a newly specified exact route/distance.
entrance_area_neighborhood.assignment_scope: Overlapping proximity options only. No mandatory all-to-one assignment, merged mega-cluster or automatic moves.

overlapping_options.source: Eric's current direct voice descriptions relayed by parent; owner-reported proximity, not independent measurement.
overlapping_options.source_quote: that whole end can kind of be criss-crossed
overlapping_options.explicit_purpose: Nearby area options with overlapping alternatives, NOT assigning one employee all listed areas.

options.seasonal_future_only: Splash Pad restrooms may join this option ONLY WHEN OPEN; excluded now.
options.additional_overlap: Cat House Cafe restrooms overlaps A through the explicitly described Bonobos/backside/back-door connection.

explicit_access_edge.status: Owner-described connection; no measured distance or walking time.

overlapping_options.limits: Membership records overlapping proximity options, not equal all-pairs distance, a transitive mega-cluster, hard cluster constraints or assignments. Do not infer walking times or automatic moves. No production integration.

karen_zambezi_tropical_route.owner_confirmed: Karen's Zambezi–Tropical Birds route is acceptable and has been used before, despite distance.
karen_zambezi_tropical_route.limits: Owner route experience/preference, not surveyed coordinates or measured walk time. Eric separately approved the reviewed Tuesday plan at 00:14 UTC; approval does not make distance measured.

assistant_proposals_not_user_approved.status: PROPOSED implementation safeguards only; not approved exact formula or requirements.
proposals: Normalize proximity and load onto comparable scales before applying 75/25.
Avoid an additional cluster bonus that could double-count proximity.

proximityIntent.no_changes: No daily assignment, lunch, handoff, database, program, HTML, PDF or production changes. No inferred walk times or exhaustive audit.

future_handoff_preference.source: Eric's explicit voice clarification, October 30, 2026 UTC
future_handoff_preference.preference: When planning future departures, spread early inherited coverage among other remaining staff before adding a small amount gradually to the 17:00 closer Xavier where needed.
future_handoff_preference.coverage_meaning: Radio/restroom alerts and issues as needed, not mandatory extra cleaning routes; Eric accepts remote reach.
future_handoff_preference.scope: Preference, not a hard prohibition or a retrospective rewrite. Wednesday's exact weighted transfers were explicitly approved after this preference.

absenceRequirement.status: AUTHORITATIVE USER REQUIREMENT for eventual program integration; not implemented or tested.

source.kind: Eric's direct voice statements relayed by parent
quotes: remove whoever calls in from the list and it recalculate and distribute those areas to people around them
wouldn't be until a third absence that I'd need to call somebody
program be able to do that within itself ... can use Gemini help, it's connected if it needs it, but preferably without any outside help, it can compute and figure it out

absenceRequirement.manager_workflow: Manager removes the call-in employee or employees from that day's list. Recalculate all their assigned areas onto remaining staff in nearby general areas using the new 75% proximity / 25% load planning method.
recalculation_scope: Regenerate the affected employee plans, not base ownership alone.
Recalculate full-hour lunch relief using employees available for each entire window.
Recalculate inherited departure handoffs and ongoing current-area ownership as people leave.
absenceRequirement.resilience_target: Handle up to TWO absences as the normal target, most of the time. This is not a guarantee that all staffing, time and coverage constraints are always feasible.
absenceRequirement.third_absence: A THIRD absence normally means Eric would call CoverAll, then assign appropriate areas to available contractor coverage instead of manually reworking the weekly schedule.
absenceRequirement.failure_handling: If hours, staffing, full-hour relief or area coverage are infeasible, explicitly flag uncovered areas/windows and the constraint. Do not invent staff availability, silently relax constraints or claim guaranteed coverage.
absenceRequirement.contractor_authority: No automatic contractor booking, outreach or assumption that requested CoverAll staff are confirmed.
absenceRequirement.baseline_scope: Preserve accepted Monday–Thursday weekly baseline plans. No current assignments, shifts, reliefs or handoffs are changed by recording this requirement.
absenceRequirement.integration_gate: Integrate the completed planning system at the end. No build, audit, solver run, program/database change or implementation claim now.
absenceRequirement.formula_limit: 75/25 weighting intent is approved; exact normalization, distance metric and calculation remain to be finalized.

internal_computation.status: AUTHORITATIVE USER REQUIREMENT, not an implementation claim
internal_computation.requirement: The program itself must compute absence redistribution, complete employee plans, full-hour lunch relief and inherited handoffs without depending on Sophia, Codex or an external cloud AI service.
internal_computation.normal_path: Preferably self-contained: normal calculation must work without outside AI assistance.
internal_computation.optional_gemini: Gemini assistance/connectivity may be considered if needed; Eric previously reported it connected, but there is no current verified connection or permission to enroll new access now. Normal computation remains self-contained.
internal_computation.no_execution: No build, service call or integration executed by saving this requirement.

baseline_and_dated_adjustment.context: Eric affirmed the explanation of preserving the weekly baseline and using dated adjustments for absences.
baseline_and_dated_adjustment.scope: Baseline plus dated adjustment is now affirmed; exact storage schema, technical implementation and solver architecture remain undecided.

proposed_solver_architecture.status: PROPOSED implementation, not Eric's exact chosen algorithm
proposed_solver_architecture.description: A deterministic constraint-validated solver could fulfill the self-contained calculation requirement, checking availability, full-hour relief, ownership and infeasible coverage.
proposed_solver_architecture.limits: Not implemented, tested, selected as the final algorithm or authorized for a build now.

existing_engine_first.source_quote: most of that ... should already be in program ... verify that it is ... computing based on our new load count
existing_engine_first.next_implementation_step: First verify which absence/recalculation capabilities already exist, then adapt the existing engine to the new group ratings, 75% proximity / 25% load intent, full-hour relief and inherited-handoff rules. Do not assume a new engine/build is needed.
existing_engine_first.evidence_limit: Eric expects much of it already exists; actual code capability and use of the new ratings are not yet verified.
existing_engine_first.scope: Requirement saved for eventual authorized implementation; no inspection, build, audit, service call or production change performed by this memory update.
